package.description: Network scanner desktop app. Discover hosts, scan TCP and UDP ports, look up DNS records and read the ARP table.

en-US.description: Network scanner desktop app. Discover hosts, scan TCP and UDP ports, look up DNS records and read the ARP table.
en-US.longDescription:
NetsCLI Desktop is the desktop app for netscli, a network scanner
with CLI, terminal UI, desktop app and MCP server interfaces, all
backed by the same Rust core. It finds hosts, scans TCP and UDP
ports, looks up DNS records and reads the ARP table in a window,
without opening a terminal.
en-US.name: NetsCLI Desktop
